objective: Test completed direction-balanced calibration and provider-informed trial targets for useful T2 recovery

clock.purge: Every go interval intersecting purchased maximum interval [30,390) is removed from all primary and secondary scoring, regardless of arm actual stop

quota.policy: Recruit eligible completed trials in observed chronological completion order; stop at first observed satisfaction or deadline390
quota.completion_recognition: (trial_stop_bin+1)*.02, requiring observed recognition bin and right_censored=false
quota.timeout: Fit all eligible trials observed by390; preserve timeout and deficits in primary evaluation
quota.short_recording: Retain unavailable outcome and observed cost; no replacement

task_target_contract.provider40ms_role: far-distance eligibility, not the trial target
task_target_contract.v9_sampling: Existing20ms paired data; geometric positions are second raw10ms sample of each pair, not exact raw10ms reproduction
task_target_contract.window_anchor: First complete pair with round(second-sample trial age*100)-1 >= round(RT*100); physical startshift0or.01seconds
task_target_contract.common_geometry_span: From first RT.2 window start through last RT.8 window end;45contiguous paired bins
eligibility: observed go onset at or after30s for training
reference40 available and distance greater than provider participant threshold
all common-span bins have finite valid target, same go, same block and passed62bin burn
nonzero finite mean displacement for both candidate windows
whole go completed and completion recognition within purchased deadline for training

target_choices.window_mean: normalize arithmetic mean of15 second-10ms-sample displacement vectors before normalization
target_choices.endpoint: original instantaneous unit direction at last bin of same15binwindow

task_target_contract.interpretation: Provider-informed geometric endpoint, stricter within-go validity; no exact provider dSNR reproduction or verified intention claim

representation.continuous_controls: V8 TX4.5+SBP transform, causal EWMA200ms, ridge1, first30s normalization
representation.trial_readouts: TX4.5+SBP sqrt-count/log1p-power transform followed by causal trailing15bin mean, reset per block; first30s normalization, scale floors.1/.01, zclip±8, unitdisk output; first1..14 bins of each block average available prefix, then15bins
representation.inference_inputs: neural features and sequence boundaries only; no behavioral context, target, trial phase, or labels
representation.trial_training: One representation vector at window end per selected trial; one matched target vector

weighting.sector: Equal total weight for each occupied cardinal-centered sector, then equal weight per trial within sector; absent sectors remain absent

selection.vary: Only RT and ridge for fixed trial-sector-window-mean policy
selection.criterion: Largest equal-session mean unchanged continuous primary R2 on exposed T2 ranks16..24 using identical common mask
selection.tie_break: Declared grid order, first exact maximum
selection.fit_outcomes_retained: Every grid and final model case, including unavailable cases; no repeated attempts discarded

controls.zero: Zero vector, zero purchased label seconds; common evaluation purge unchanged
controls.constant: Uniform mean original instantaneous purchased labels30:390
controls.trialshuffle: One fixed cyclic rotation of primary selected trial target vectors; not a permutation null test

primary_endpoint.target: Unchanged original continuous instantaneous unit cursor-to-target direction
primary_endpoint.mask: validgo+blockburn+common392:600+uniontrialpurge; no geometry eligibility or quota attainment filtering

secondary_endpoint.unit: Completed eligible heldouttrial, one predictedvector at selectedRTwindowend

gates.quota_attainment: Report separately for all selected cases; never condition scoring on success

uncertainty.aggregation: Equal sessions within each participant, then equal participants
uncertainty.T2_units: Six sessions from one known person, descriptive and not independent participant replication
uncertainty.multiplicity: One fixed primary recovery test; target, weighting, duration and participant contrasts descriptive without multiplicity-adjusted significance claims

mechanistic_contrasts.duration_minus_baseline: additional recorded calibration for unchanged continuous decoder
mechanistic_contrasts.primary_minus_quota_continuous: trial-target representation bundle at same stop
mechanistic_contrasts.quota_sector_mean_minus_quota_uniform_me: sector weighting with exact same trials,target and representation
mechanistic_contrasts.quota_sector_mean_minus_quota_sector_end: window-mean versus endpoint target with same trials,weights and representation
mechanistic_contrasts.trial_duration_sector_mean_minus_primary: fixed full budget versus quota stop under same selected recipe

access_order: commit fixed acquisition plan before downloading raw archives
complete synthetic tests and commit study plan+scientific producers before source fits
independently audit source model reconstruction and source choice
commit audited source selection and hashes before fresh signal conversion
run fresh assessment once, independently reconstruct it, then publish allowlisted aggregates

private: trial identities and per-trial selection maps
public: aggregate counts, cost, deficits, scores, uncertainty, failures
code, protocols, immutable hashes, audits, cohort dispositions
publication.runtime: Fresh accuracy is separate from any source engineering replay; no closed-loop or hard-realtime claim

fallback.below_minimum: Zero output, retain all scores and disclose count
fallback.one_trial: Free-intercept ridge can only fit a constant; not evidence of direction coverage
fallback.incomplete_calibration: No deployment before requested policy stop; short recording retains unavailable score
